There’s a storage company called cube smart that has locations all over Austin for storing stuff if you want to bring your stuff now — if you want to wait and see if the company will help later that’s obviously an option too.

When I moved Philly => Austin a few years back I used this company called “pods”, that’s technically a storage company but they have branches all over the US and you can pay them to move your pod from one location to another.

And unlike the self storage options, they literally drop what is essentially a high quality shipping container in front of your place and then move it either into storage or somewhere else. They were easy to work with, would recommend if you need
